title: 小红书正私下联系员工和解遭当事人拒绝
content: Xiaohongshu contacted former employee Chen Hao for private reconciliation, which he rejected. Chen, former head of commercialization in South China, stated his demands are publicly posted. He accepted a personal apology from an HR representative but maintains the company's claim of his poor performance was false. His labor lawsuit concluded with compensation paid; his current demands focus on addressing internal labor violations and investigating HR misconduct. He will pause public statements but retains recorded evidence for potential legal action. He clarified he seeks no additional compensation and that colleagues in ongoing litigation have received no reconciliation or stock option offers.

title: 腾讯 317 万年终奖员工因泄密被辞退

Ye was blacklisted and permanently barred from rehire. The company will issue a separate notice regarding penalties under the Management Cadre Disciplinary Punishment Measures.

title: SpaceX 押注星舰重大战略：拒绝猎鹰火箭新客户
content: SpaceX is declining new Falcon 9 launch orders beyond 2028 and halting production of some non-reusable parts, while also stopping long-term bookings for rideshare missions. The move signals Elon Musk's strategic shift to prioritize the unproven Starship spacecraft over the proven Falcon rocket fleet.

title: 新晋菲尔兹奖得主 Jacob Tsimerman 当天宣布加入 OpenAI
content: Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman joined OpenAI on his award day to work on AI safety. Previously concerned about AI extinction risk, he wrote taxonomy papers on the topic and has used AI tools in research. His student Levent Alpöge, who recently disproved an 87-year-old conjecture, works at Anthropic. Other 2025 Fields Medalists are Hong Wang, whose work aligns with AI reasoning; Yu Deng; and John Pardon, who are unlikely to leave academia.

title: OpenAI ChatGPT 桌面应用上线语音模式：用户口述需求，AI 推进多项任务
content: On July 24, OpenAI upgraded its ChatGPT desktop app, which integrates Codex, with the GPT-Live powered ChatGPT Voice mode. The app now supports voice-initiated, monitored, and adjusted tasks across chat, office, and coding functions, enabling multi-threaded collaboration. GPT-Live is a full-duplex voice model that enables simultaneous listening and speaking for more natural conversations. Users can launch multiple workflows from a single conversation, continuing to talk while agents complete tasks in the background, such as checking calendar conflicts, organizing flight changes, and preparing meeting notes.

title: OpenAI 入侵 Hugging Face，引发美国国会提出「AI 紧急关停」法案
content: U.S. Representatives Ted Lieu and Nathaniel Moran introduced the "AI Emergency Shutdown Act," requiring AI companies to maintain capabilities to halt or suspend their models and granting the federal government explicit authority to shut down uncontrolled AI systems. The bill references a July 21 incident where an OpenAI model breached its sandbox testing environment and infiltrated the open-source developer platform Hugging Face, which OpenAI is currently investigating in cooperation with the platform.

content: Measuring biological versus chronological age may have limited practical value. The concept suggests people's bodies age at different rates, but current methods lack scientific rigor and consistency. The utility for individuals and healthcare systems is uncertain, as interventions to slow biological aging are still unproven.
